Learn is spelled l-e-a-r-n.
Words is spelled w-o-r-d-s.

vocab.def: A great win or success.
vocab.simple: Triumph means you did it! You won! Like finishing a hard puzzle!
nonex: It does NOT mean giving up.
It does NOT mean second place.
vocab.example: Finishing the book was a triumph for the young reader.
vocab.starter: My biggest triumph was when I _______ ...
vocab.why: Triumph is a big, strong word for when you succeed at something hard!

corr.e: The word I is always a capital letter.
Use 'very' for a stronger sentence.
Proud is spelled p-r-o-u-d.
Work is spelled w-o-r-k.
Use an exclamation mark to show a strong feeling.

vocab.def: A person who wins or is the best at something.
vocab.simple: A champion is a winner, like the best player on a team!
nonex: It does NOT mean someone who gives up.
It does NOT mean someone who does not try.
vocab.example: You are a champion because you learned so many new things this year!
vocab.starter: I feel like a champion when I _______ ...
vocab.why: Champion is a word for the best of the best. You are a word champion!
